title: InclusiveShift-HAR: An Auditable Participant-Exclusive Benchmark for Ability-Associated Population Shift in Smartphone Activity Recognition
description: Research software for auditable, participant-exclusive released-block evaluation of ability-associated population shift in smartphone inertial human activity recognition. The released cohort label is not a direct measure of physical ability. InclusiveHAR v4 trial boundaries are unrecoverable, so this is not claimed to be trial-safe. The locked benchmark retains an unsupported MoRe-HAR model hypothesis and makes no fairness, clinical-validity, causal-disability, state-of-the-art, publication-acceptance, or minted-DOI claim.
notes: Apache-2.0 covers repository-authored material only. Third-party datasets, legacy coursework artifacts, checkpoints, papers, and figures retain their own licences and citations. This file prepares future release metadata and does not represent an existing public release or DOI.
